title: PARDUS Super Sport Gen2 configuration and eGR review
notes: Current public exact-model videos consistently report CNY 4,999 for the L-TWOO eGR and Magene PES single-ring electronic builds and CNY 6,999 for the Shimano 105 build. The eGR review also identifies a 50T chainring, 11–42T cassette, 160 mm rotors, aluminum split cockpit and no included pedals. Treat prices as public market observations rather than guaranteed checkout prices.
